title: Creative Production: Building Esports Identities, Marketing material for long-term vision
challenge: With challenges including the pandemic, limited tournament infrastructure and budget constraints, I introduced a pre-season media production approach to create a consistent pool of player content, fulfilling media requirements while building a stronger and more recognizable & consistent player identity over time.
actions:
Like in other traditional sports, Esports players are representative and influential faces of the industry. My role was to shape and elevate Free Fire players' identities through a cohesive creative direction, making them more professional, competitive and distinctive while preserving the voice of the younger generation and the authenticity of the community.

To bring this vision to life, I developed creative media concepts that balanced brand objectives, audience relevance and execution feasibility.
